text: For the one directing. On a stringed instrument. Of David. 1 Hear, O God, my cry; attend to my prayer.
From the end of the earth I call out to You in the feebleness of my heart; may You lead me to the rock that is higher than I.
For You have been a place of refuge for me, a tower of strength against the face of the enemy.
Let me sojourn in Your Tent forever; I will take refuge in the shelter of Your wings. Selah
for You, O God, have listend to my vows; You have appointed the inheritance of those fearing Your name.
May You add days to the days of the king; [may] his years [be] as generation and generation.
May he dwell forever before God; may You appoint loving devotion and faithfulness to guard him.
So I will sing praise to your name forever, that I may perform my vows, day [by] day.
